tasks.label: Arduino: Build+Upload Heliostat (S3)
tasks.command: set -e && echo '==> Detecting port' && PORT=$(ls -t /dev/cu.usbmodem* /dev/cu.usbserial* 2>/dev/null | head -n1) && if [ -z "$PORT" ]; then echo 'No serial port found - connect device first'; exit 1; fi && echo "Found: $PORT" && echo '==> Compiling ESP32-S3' && arduino-cli compile --fqbn esp32:esp32:adafruit_feather_esp32s3_reversetft heliostat.ino --output-dir build && echo "==> Uploading to $PORT" && arduino-cli upload --fqbn esp32:esp32:adafruit_feather_esp32s3_reversetft --port "$PORT" --input-dir build && echo '==> Upload complete'

tasks.label: Arduino: Monitor (auto-detect)
tasks.command: pkill -f 'arduino-cli monitor' || true && PORT=$(ls -t /dev/cu.usbmodem* /dev/cu.usbserial* 2>/dev/null | head -n1) && if [ -z "$PORT" ]; then echo 'No serial port found'; exit 1; fi && echo "==> Monitoring $PORT at 115200" && arduino-cli monitor --port "$PORT" --config baudrate=115200

tasks.label: Arduino: Build+Upload+Monitor (S3)
tasks.command: set -e && echo '==> Killing existing monitors' && pkill -f 'arduino-cli monitor' || true && sleep 1 && echo '==> Waiting for device (press reset or button)' && TRIES=0 && while [ $TRIES -lt 30 ]; do PORT=$(ls -t /dev/cu.usbmodem* /dev/cu.usbserial* 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [ -n "$PORT" ]; then break; fi; echo "Scanning ($TRIES/30)..."; sleep 1; TRIES=$((TRIES+1)); done && if [ -z "$PORT" ]; then echo 'Timeout waiting for device'; exit 1; fi && echo "Found: $PORT" && echo '==> Compiling ESP32-S3' && arduino-cli compile --fqbn esp32:esp32:adafruit_feather_esp32s3_reversetft heliostat.ino --output-dir build && echo "==> Uploading to $PORT" && arduino-cli upload --fqbn esp32:esp32:adafruit_feather_esp32s3_reversetft --port "$PORT" --input-dir build && echo '==> Waiting for re-enumeration' && sleep 2 && NEWPORT=$(ls -t /dev/cu.usbmodem* /dev/cu.usbserial* 2>/dev/null | head -n1) && PORT="${NEWPORT:-$PORT}" && echo "==> Monitoring $PORT at 115200" && arduino-cli monitor --port "$PORT" --config baudrate=115200

tasks.label: Arduino: Monitor (scan + auto-reconnect)
tasks.command: while true; do PORT=$(ls -t /dev/cu.usbmodem* /dev/cu.usbserial* 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [ -z "$PORT" ]; then echo 'No port found. Scanning again in 2s...'; sleep 2; continue; fi; echo "Connecting to $PORT (115200). Ctrl+C to stop."; arduino-cli monitor --port "$PORT" --config baudrate=115200 || true; echo 'Monitor disconnected. Waiting 2s...'; sleep 2; done
